description: 点击 Ant Design Tabs 指定文本的 tab 并返回切换后状态。

steps.expression: (() => { const target = '{{tabText}}'; const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')); for (const tab of tabs) { const t = (tab.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === target) { tab.click(); const active = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active'); return { ok: true, clicked: t, activeAfter: (active?.textContent || '').trim() }; } } return { ok: false, error: 'tab_not_found', target, available: tabs.slice(0, 15).map(t => (t.textContent || '').trim()) }; })()
